About Pathify

Pathify’s AI-powered Campus Experience Platform (CXP) ends the digital runaround in higher education — the maze of systems, logins and unread emails fracturing the student journey. Pathify powers colleges and universities with one connected experience where prospective and enrolled students, faculty, staff, parents, and alumni communicate, get answers and finish tasks without switching systems. More than 300 campuses trust Pathify to power their digital transformation, eliminating the dead ends that erode reputation, credibility — and enrollment.
